name: image
description: Multi-label dataset. The image benchmark dataset consists of 2000 natural scene images. Zhou and Zhang (2007) extracted 135 features for each image and made it publicly available as processed image dataset. Each observation can be associated with different label sets, where all possible labels are {desert, mountains, sea, sunset, trees}. About 22% of the images belong to more than one class. However, images belonging to three classes or more are very rare.
